title: The Soldier Who Fought for America and the Soviet Union

scenes.headline: BOTH SIDES
scenes.text: The soldier who fought for America. And the Soviet Union.

scenes.headline: BOTH SIDES
scenes.text: Same war. Two armies. One man.

scenes.headline: D-DAY 1944
scenes.text: June sixth, nineteen forty-four. Joseph Beyrle jumps into Normandy with the hundred and first Airborne.

scenes.headline: CAPTURED
scenes.text: He is captured by the Germans. Back home, his family is told he is dead.

scenes.headline: ESCAPE
scenes.text: He escapes. He is caught. He escapes again.

scenes.headline: RUN EAST
scenes.text: January, nineteen forty-five. He breaks out of a prison camp and runs toward the Soviet army.

scenes.headline: DON'T SHOOT
scenes.text: He walks out with his hands up, shouting: American comrade!

scenes.headline: SOVIET TANKS
scenes.text: A Soviet tank unit lets him join. He fights with them for about a month.

scenes.headline: WOUNDED
scenes.text: Then he is badly wounded and sent to a Soviet hospital.

scenes.headline: HOME
scenes.text: He reaches Moscow, then America. Alive. The man his family had mourned.
